mission.goal: Replace the mistaken mixed 637-row Form Copilot source with the supplied 519-row valid CSV dataset, reset production job state to that dataset, deploy it, and publish the correction to main.
mission.target: Form Copilot fixed dataset, production PostgreSQL scheduling state, production deployment, and repository main branch.
includes: Validate the supplied CSV has 519 unique complete rows with the exact 46-column schema
Generate the fixed runtime dataset from that CSV without adding screening-excluded rows
Update dataset validation, tests, documentation and displayed counts
Reset Form Copilot production batch/job state while preserving an external backup
Deploy the verified image and merge the correction to main
excludes: Submitting any Google Form response during deployment
Deleting or changing existing Google Form Responses
Inventing or modifying values in the supplied CSV
Changing the fixed Google Form target or linked response Sheet
outputs: A runtime dataset containing exactly the supplied 519 records
Reset production scheduling history aligned to the corrected source
Healthy production deployment and published main branch

doneWhen.evidence: The backend loads exactly 519 unique complete records whose digest derives from the supplied CSV.
Typecheck, tests and production build pass for the corrected dataset.
Production PostgreSQL scheduling state is reset after backup and production reports the corrected 519-row dataset.
The correction is merged and pushed non-force to main.

mission.verification: Validate CSV shape, IDs and values; run the full Form Copilot check; back up and reset production scheduling tables; deploy; verify authenticated production metadata reports 519 total/completing and zero screened-out rows.
mission.example: The Form Copilot panel shows 519 total records, 519 full-form records, zero early-close records, and no prior batch or job remains selectable.

impacts.behavior: The application selects only exact complete rows from the supplied 519-row CSV and no longer exposes or schedules screening-excluded rows from the previous workbook.

business.reason: The valid-only source replaces the mistaken mixed source.

architecture.reason: Dataset provenance and runtime validation change together.

backend.reason: Runtime dataset and validation must accept the corrected source.

data.reason: Old production scheduling state must not retain rows from the wrong dataset.
verification: Zero batches and jobs after reset

interface.reason: No layout or interface structure changes.

audit.reason: No rendered presentation values change beyond backend-provided counts.

uat.reason: Production must report the exact corrected dataset without submitting a form.

quality.reason: The correction requires full repository gates.

reconciliation.reason: Published and deployed results must match the corrected source promise.
verification: Source digest, Git head and production image align
